protocol_type: Request/reply application-layer protocol. The client (a.k.a master in legacy serial terminology) initiates every transaction by sending a Function Code + Data PDU, and the server (a.k.a slave) replies with either a normal response that echoes the function code with response data, or an exception response (Function Code | 0x80) + Exception Code. The same PDU rides three published ADU framings: Modbus RTU (binary + CRC-16), Modbus ASCII (ASCII hex + LRC + CR LF), and Modbus TCP (binary PDU prefixed by 7-byte MBAP header on TCP port 502).

opcodes.name: Mask Write Register
opcodes.operation: Result = (Current AND AND_Mask) OR (OR_Mask AND (NOT AND_Mask))

MEI_types.name: CANopen General Reference Request and Response PDU

function_code_ranges.Public_low_range: 1..64 + 73..99 + 111..127 — well-defined / unique / validated / publicly documented / conformance-tested
function_code_ranges.Reserved_range: Listed in Annex A; legacy / proprietary codes (FC 8/19, 8/21-65535, 9, 10, 13, 14, 41, 42, 90, 91, 125, 126, 127; FC 43 sub-MEI 0-12 and 15-255)
function_code_ranges.Exception_response_range: 128..255 — Function code OR 0x80; data byte = Exception Code

exception_codes.name: ILLEGAL FUNCTION
exception_codes.meaning: Function code received is not an allowable action for the server (not implemented, or server not in a state to process it).

exception_codes.name: ILLEGAL DATA ADDRESS
exception_codes.meaning: Combination of reference number and transfer length is invalid for the server's data space.

exception_codes.name: ILLEGAL DATA VALUE
exception_codes.meaning: Value in the query data field is not allowable, or the structural length of a complex request is wrong. Does NOT mean the application-level value of a register is out of range.

exception_codes.name: SERVER DEVICE FAILURE
exception_codes.meaning: Unrecoverable internal error while attempting to perform the requested action.

exception_codes.name: ACKNOWLEDGE
exception_codes.meaning: Used with programming commands. Server accepted the request and will need a long time to complete it; reply prevents client timeout. Client may issue Poll Program Complete.

exception_codes.name: SERVER DEVICE BUSY
exception_codes.meaning: Server is engaged in another long-duration program command; client should retransmit later.

exception_codes.name: MEMORY PARITY ERROR
exception_codes.meaning: Used with FC 20 / 21 and reference type 6. Extended file area failed a consistency check.

exception_codes.name: GATEWAY PATH UNAVAILABLE
exception_codes.meaning: Gateway was unable to allocate an internal communication path from the input port to the output port. Usually means the gateway is misconfigured or overloaded.

exception_codes.name: GATEWAY TARGET DEVICE FAILED TO RESPOND
exception_codes.meaning: Gateway forwarded the request but no response was obtained from the target device on its sub-network.

channels.name: Modbus RTU on EIA/TIA-485
channels.error_check: CRC-16-Modbus (poly 0xA001 reflected; init 0xFFFF; low-byte-first on wire)

channels.name: Modbus ASCII on serial
channels.direction: half/full duplex depending on physical layer

channels.name: Modbus TCP
channels.error_check: TCP/IP checksum + Ethernet CRC-32 (no additional Modbus CRC)

host_bus_interface: Implementation-defined. Typical IP-core RTL exposes (a) an APB / AHB / AXI slave port for register configuration + four mapped data tables, and (b) a UART or Ethernet-MAC port for the ADU on the wire. No standardized MODBUS CPU-bus is mandated.
valid_ready_handshake_rules: MODBUS is strictly request/reply at the application layer — there is no per-byte ACK at the application layer; ACK is implicit in the normal response PDU.
On serial transports (RTU/ASCII) the server shall not reply to a broadcast address-0 frame.
If the server detects a transmission error (parity / framing / CRC / LRC), it shall not send any reply; the client times out and may retransmit.
On Modbus TCP the client may pipeline multiple outstanding transactions by varying MBAP.Transaction_ID; the server shall include the same Transaction_ID in the matching response.
Client should manage a request timeout to avoid indefinite waits when the network drops the response.
Programming-style long-duration commands may return exception 0x05 ACKNOWLEDGE so the client can poll for completion without timing out.

frame_format_rtu.data: 0..252 bytes; layout depends on function code.
frame_format_rtu.error_check: CRC-16-Modbus, 2 bytes, low byte first on the wire.
frame_format_rtu.framing: End-of-frame indicated by ≥ 3.5 character-time silence on the line.

frame_format_ascii.data: 2N ASCII-hex characters (encodes N bytes of PDU data).
frame_format_ascii.error_check: LRC over Address + Function + Data, 2 ASCII-hex characters (1 byte).

frame_format_tcp.transaction_id: 2 bytes. Set by client; echoed by server. Allows pipelined transactions on a single TCP socket.
frame_format_tcp.length: 2 bytes. Number of following bytes = Unit ID + PDU = 1 + len(PDU).
frame_format_tcp.unit_id: 1 byte. Server address on a sub-network behind a gateway; 0xFF or 0x00 used when the TCP endpoint is itself the MODBUS server.
